summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without committing or running tests. Changes: UnderlineBar gains clickable_ranges (one Text object, click spans last, skipped on zero-width early path); Opacity now merges the blended color into existing styles, preserving click metadata; new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py with Tab, TabsRenderable, and Tabs; docs/reference/tabs.md; sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css; new tests in tests/test_tabs.py plus additions to test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py. The layout resolver needed no change because its Edge already had min_size and fraction defaults. Verification was by reading only; no test run. Caveats: Tabs sets can_focus=True (not in spec, needed for keys); the spec's find_tab_by_name-based bar position can misalign with displayed tabs when duplicate names precede the active tab; layout_resolve treats a zero-width empty label as flexible.
